text:
Jack Hughes was named the NHL's second star of the week and he's on a six-game point streak (five goals, seven assists). He has 26 points in 19 games, and the Devils take 64% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, a dominant number.

None of it looks fluky. His shooting (11.8%) is a touch below normal on 10.9 expected goals, and New Jersey's on-ice finishing is close to average. By our win probability, his goals have added more wins than all but nine skaters. He played 61 games last season; healthy, this is what he looks like.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has the full set: 97th percentile for chances from the slot, 69% of exits with possession, 58% of entries carried in. One blog has him as the best 3-on-3 player in the world. Our range: 89 to 120 points.
